invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$78.5（基于ATR 0.5747和约1.7%风险，收紧以保护资本），或融资费率转为正值（>0%）显示轧空机会消失，或日线跌破$77关键支撑。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $78.5 (based on ATR 0.5747 and ~1.7% risk, tightened to protect capital), or funding rate turns positive (>0%) indicating short squeeze opportunity fading, or daily break below $77 key support.

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$2050（基于ATR 13.8131和约2.6%风险），或融资费率转为正值（>0%）显示轧空机会消失，或日线跌破$2000关键支撑。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $2050 (based on ATR 13.8131 and ~2.6% risk), or funding rate turns positive (>0%) indicating short squeeze opportunity fading, or daily break below $2000 key support.

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$0.088（基于ATR 0.0005和约2.8%风险），或融资费率Z-score升至>50%显示轧多风险加剧，或日线跌破$0.085关键支撑。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $0.088 (based on ATR 0.0005 and ~2.8% risk), or funding rate Z-score rises to >50% indicating long squeeze risk intensifying, or daily break below $0.085 key support.
